Record Class ImportJobRegistry.JobSnapshot

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.sebastiandorata.musicdashboard.service.Import.ImportJobRegistry.JobSnapshot
Record Components:
jobId - the job id
state - the job state
current - 1-based index of the file being processed (0 before the first file)
total - total number of files (0 until known)
fileName - short name of the file being processed
message - failure text when the state is FAILED, otherwise null
results - one entry per evaluated file (empty until the job is done)
startedAt - when the job was created
Enclosing class:
ImportJobRegistry
public static record ImportJobRegistry.JobSnapshot(String jobId, ImportJobRegistry.State state, int current, int total, String fileName, String message, List<MigrationResult> results, Instant startedAt) extends Record
Read-only view of a job returned to the browser.
